## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and SPY (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) BELOW TREND with TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ABOVE TREND — SPY/TLT ↓ falling — two independent confirmations of cautious risk posture.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear rising: VXX (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Stocks vs Bonds signaling risk-off: SPY (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) BELOW TREND / TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ABOVE TREND → SPY/TLT ↓ falling. Credit mixed: HYG (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND despite system flag HYG_LQD: CREDIT STRESS ↓.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP (1W: +0.11% | 1M: -2.22%) RECOVERY and the yield curve (via TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ABOVE TREND) showing modest steepening ↑ rising.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: XLB (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND — style: cyclicals/commodities favored over growth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US struggling: SPY (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) BELOW TREND. EM outperforming: EEM (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +5.84%) ABOVE TREND and Japan EWJ (1W: +4.98% | 1M: +10.36%) ABOVE TREND. China weak: FXI (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -4.27%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Cooling. ARKK (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -15.56%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -29.71%) BELOW TREND show speculative flows retrenching; IWM (1W: -0.78% | 1M: -0.09%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Gold safe-haven bid: GLD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial metals soft: CPER (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND — signals slowing cyclical demand.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy firm: XLE (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) ABOVE TREND. Natural gas volatile/correcting: UNG (1W: -6.25% | 1M: +21.48%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Rising VXX (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ABOVE TREND support a cautious regime. DIVERGENCE: Minor — multiple 1W/1M mismatches in commodities and energy (UNG, BNO, USO) but no major divergence across core ETFs (SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT).

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor XLE (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.27% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND; maintain cautious bond exposure via TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) ABOVE TREND if energy stays bid. BULLISH: XLB (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%) ABOVE TREND on industrial reflation. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND if tech momentum fails to stabilize.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%) ABOVE TREND on safe-haven flows. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND and watch UNG (1W: -6.25% | 1M: +21.48%) CORRECTION for volatility spillovers.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~29 (elevated fear, VXX (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) ABOVE TREND). SPY/TLT ratio ~7.60 (SPY (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) BELOW TREND vs TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ABOVE TREND). XLK/XLF ~2.70 (Tech vs Financial pivot, tech weakness).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. XLE (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) and XLB (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%) showing relative strength while XLK (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%) shows weakness. Key risk: rising VXX (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) and SPY/TLT ↓ falling—monitor volatility and commodity 1W/1M divergences (UNG corrections).
